Business.title: India's Banking Sector Eyes Sustainable Growth as Retail Lending and Capex Shape FY27 Outlook
Business.summary: India's banking sector is expected to experience sustainable growth in FY27, driven by strong asset quality, stable funding costs, and healthy credit growth. The sector's performance will depend on balanced retail lending, a revival in corporate capex, and prudent regulatory oversight. This growth is crucial for maintaining financial stability in the country.

Business.title: India Inc is returning to banks for money, but retail borrowers aren’t keeping pace
Business.summary: India's largest private banks are witnessing a shift in credit demand, with corporate and SME lending driving loan growth, while retail borrowing remains subdued. This trend is expected to impact banks' funding mix and margins, as they rely on stronger working capital demand, refinancing, and business banking to boost advances. The slower consumer credit growth may weigh on banks' overall performance.

Business.title: Emergent Raises Series C at $1.5 Billion Valuation, Becomes Unicorn in a Year of Launch
Business.summary: Emergent, an AI software creation platform, has raised $130 million in Series C funding, valuing the company at $1.5 billion and making it a unicorn within a year of its launch. The funding round was led by Creaegis, with participation from prominent investors such as Khosla Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. This development highlights the growing interest in AI-powered software creation platforms.

National Affairs.title: Bhojshala row: SC to hear Muslim side's plea on alternate namaz site on Friday
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court will hear a plea related to the Bhojshala complex in Dhar, where a dispute has arisen over the site's use for namaz. The petitioners have alleged certain issues and the court has agreed to hear their plea. This case highlights the ongoing tensions and disputes over religious sites in India.

National Affairs.title: Delhi protesters want to plunge India into chaos: Zoho's Sridhar Vembu calls for defeating the 'malicious agenda'
National Affairs.summary: Zoho CEO Sridhar Vembu has stated that Delhi protesters aim to cause chaos and halt national progress, sparking a debate on social media about the nature of protests and democratic rights. Many users argued that peaceful protest is a fundamental right and that citizens need accountability between elections. The Supreme Court declined an urgent listing for a plea against police action, stating it was not interested in viewing videos at the mentioning stage.

National Affairs.title: 'Don't Want To Watch Any Videos': SC On Plea Against Delhi Police For Alleged Crackdown
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court declined to hear a petition against Delhi Police for their alleged crackdown during a protest, stating that it did not want to watch videos related to the case at the mentioning stage. This decision highlights the court's approach to handling pleas related to protests and police action. The case is significant as it raises questions about the balance between maintaining law and order and protecting citizens' rights.

National Affairs.title: Why is India adding more Supreme Court judges? Explained
National Affairs.summary: The Indian government is seeking to increase the number of Supreme Court judges, excluding the Chief Justice of India, from 33 to 37. This move aims to address the court's workload and improve its efficiency. The expansion of the court's strength is significant as it may impact the judiciary's ability to handle cases and deliver justice in a timely manner.
